cues.text: That knight just stole a rook from there.

That knight just took a rook from three squares away.
This is Chaos Chess. Play a friend, find an opponent, or practice against the A I.
Choose an opening anomaly for a match-long twist. Or skip it and start playing.
Every five turns, pick one of three powers. Upgrade your pieces, and watch what your opponent picks too.
A Knook adds rook moves to a knight. But it can still be captured. Your powers change the tactics, not the goal.
Find the threats. Protect your king. Here, a Camel's longer jump finishes the game with checkmate.
Choose two plus one, five plus three, or a longer game. Clocks pause while drafting.
Browse the leaderboard, watch games live, or replay a match to study the powers.
